searchText: A general question for all client teams, has everyone implemented terminal block hash override functionality? Specifically `TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH` and `TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH_ACTIVATION_EPOCH` in the `config.yaml`? Geth has no terminal block hash override functionality Erigon hasn't implemented it yet. Nethermind hasn't implemented it yet. We will use --Merge.TerminalBlockHash and we can specify it in config now, but we haven't merged it with Engine API yet. Btw maybe we should have hive tests for such case? Prysm has but we haven't tested in a while besu has TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH implemented in genesis.json, it can be specified and/or overridden via cli param also yes lodestar has implemented but there is a fix in works regarding them, should be out in a day or two Nimbus has at least never tested it, so assuming it doesn't work Teku has implemented but testing is pretty spotty. Yes, I think I can implement these fairly quickly 👍
